items.title: 2.7 tonnes of cocaine found in elaborate bunker system at Sydney property
items.description: A record 2.7 tonnes of cocaine worth an estimated street value of $816 million has been seized at a semi-rural property in Greater Western Sydney.

items.title: Live: Albanese to meet with state leaders to talk fuel security
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese will convene a virtual meeting of the national cabinet to discuss fuel security.  Follow live.

items.title: 'You won't make it back': Trump's threat to Iran reps at peace talks
items.description: Donald Trump warns the Iranian delegation they might not return home from talks in Switzerland talks as the US and Iran argue over the fate of the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Victoria ended native forest logging. So where are these trees coming from?
items.description: Four Corners follows the logs, and the money, to uncover how efforts to end logging have shifted the timber trade across state borders.

items.title: British PM set to resign after challenger's thumping by-election win
items.description: Less than two years after being elected in a landslide, the Labour PM is expected to announce his resignation to make way for another leader.

items.title: There's more to housing demand than population growth
items.description: The problem for both the Coalition and Labor is that things are only going to get more difficult for ordinary families in the years ahead, and the economic environment is likely to keep favouring One Nation's message.

items.title: Black swan 'wipe-out' predicted as dead birds reported along WA coast
items.description: More than a dozen dead birds that washed up on southern WA beaches are reported to authorities amid concerns an outbreak of avian influenza is spreading.

items.title: Concerns over AI and data centres a dangerous force for Labor
items.description: While the government is trying to assure people there is nothing to fear from AI, many think technology is moving too quickly for authorities to keep up.

items.title: Live: Cabo Verde stun Uruguay with thundrous free kick, as keeper hero's mum celebrates in stands
items.description: Cabo Verde stuns Uruguay with its first ever World Cup goal, as hero goalkeeper has mum in the stands following last ditch bid for visa successful. Follow live.

items.title: Trump threatens to resume war as Vance holds talks with Iran
items.description: US President Donald Trump has threatened to restart the US war with Iran at the same time his vice-president has been meeting with Iranian officials for the first talks under an interim peace deal.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers

items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
